variants.name: Band Good Morning
variants.difference: Shown: good morning. Stand on a band and loop it across your upper back.

variants.name: Band Overhead Triceps Extension
variants.difference: Shown: overhead triceps extension. Use a band anchored under your back foot instead of a dumbbell.

variants.name: Barbell Rollout
variants.difference: Shown: ab wheel rollout. Roll a loaded barbell out the same way.

variants.name: Battle Rope Alternating Waves
variants.difference: Shown: double waves. Move one arm up while the other goes down.

variants.name: Cable Lying Leg Curl
variants.difference: Shown: leg curl. Lie face down with a cable strapped to one ankle and curl your heel up.

variants.name: Cable Reverse Curl
variants.difference: Shown: reverse curl. Use a straight bar on a low cable, palms facing down.

variants.name: Jackknife Sit-Up
variants.difference: Shown: V-up. Reach your hands toward your feet as your legs lift.

variants.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Carry
variants.difference: Shown: front-rack carry. Hold kettlebells at your shoulders the same way.

variants.name: Monster Walk
variants.difference: Shown: band side walk. Step forward and out on a diagonal instead of straight sideways.

variants.name: Neutral-Grip Seated Row
variants.difference: Shown: seated row. Use a handle where your palms face each other.

variants.name: Rope Pushdown
variants.difference: Shown: pushdown. Use the rope and spread the ends apart at the bottom.

variants.name: Scissor Kicks
variants.difference: Shown: flutter kicks. Cross your legs over each other side to side instead of up and down.

variants.name: Single-Arm Cable Lat Pulldown
variants.difference: Shown: lat pulldown. Kneel at a cable and pull one handle down at a time.

variants.name: Spot Jogging
variants.difference: Shown: high knees. Jog on the spot at an easy pace with lower knees.

variants.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
variants.difference: Shown: Romanian deadlift. Keep your knees almost straight and lower the weight a little further.

variants.name: V-Bar Row
variants.difference: Shown: seated row. Use the V-bar handle, palms facing each other.

variants.name: Walking Lunge
variants.difference: Shown: lunge. Step forward into each rep and keep walking instead of returning.

variants.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
variants.difference: Shown: lat pulldown. Hold the bar wider than your shoulders.
